notes:
Account: BrightCart Global — large multiregional retailer, primary use-case is product catalog semantic search + reranking for ecomm site and native apps. Catalog: ~15M SKUs (including variants), daily feed from S3, expected top-k retrieval then rerank top-50 candidates on reranker; POC goals: 99th pctile latency <250ms end-to-end (retrieval + rerank), median <120ms for UI flows. Cost sensitivity: target blended cost-per-query <= $0.003 on peak traffic; realistic target for dedicated commit around $0.0015/query with batching and KV cache. Seasonal: Black Friday / Cyber Week peak ~8-12x baseline traffic; needs burst capacity and predictable throttling/fallback (lower-quality cheaper model) during spikes. Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 13 months, KMS with BYOK, EU data residency for EU customer segment. Technical notes: embedding dim 1536 for retrieval; store both dense vectors and product metadata in index; reranker model will run on top-k 50, likely a small cross-encoder quantized to int8 to save ops. POC plan: 3 weeks — week1 ingest 500k sample, week2 scale to 5M and measure QPS/latency/cost, week3 run peak spike test and fallbacks.
Recent quotes: "We need predictable cost during the holiday spike — can't have 5x bill surprises." "If you can show dedicated committed pricing that hits our q/¢ target we can move to procurement."
Open items: KMS integration diagram, residency proof for EU data, final pricing for 24/7 burst to 10x. Linked artifacts: pricing deck, security FAQ, POC plan.
